split.rule: Global chronological split on unique local_date values. Earliest 70% of dates → train, next 15% → validation, latest 15% → test. Rows that share a calendar date are never split across partitions.
split.embargo_reason: No embargo gap was added. Lag and rolling features use only past calendar days, so a date-boundary split does not leak future labels into the predictors.

selection.criterion: Choose the classifier with the highest validation-set F1-score for the hazard class (label=1). Break remaining ties with validation recall, then with the simpler estimator in this order: logistic_regression, decision_tree, linear_svm, random_forest. The untouched chronological test set is not used for model or threshold selection.

hyperparameters.standardization: StandardScaler on training features; estimator standardization disabled

linear_svm.name: linear_svm
linear_svm.attribution_note: Linear SVM coefficients after scaling. These are not feature importance.

hyperparameters.standardization: StandardScaler on training features; estimator standardization disabled
hyperparameters.probability_note: LinearSVC does not emit calibrated probabilities. Ranking uses the decision function.

persistence.name: persistence
persistence.description: Predict next-day hazard if today's daily mean PM2.5 already exceeds 60.0 µg/m³. Uses only information available at the prediction cutoff.

majority.name: majority_class
majority.description: Always predict class 1, the majority label in the training partition. This ignores all features and is a weak reference.
